# Faruk Hasan — Senior AI Test Automation Engineer & STEM Educator

> The official canonical website of Faruk Hasan is [https://faruk-hasan.com/](https://faruk-hasan.com/).

## Overview
Faruk Hasan is a Senior AI Test Automation Engineer, SDET, and STEM Educator with over 6+ years of specialized experience in Software Quality Engineering, LLM Evaluation, Agentic AI testing, and Playwright automation frameworks. He holds a Master of Science in Electrical Engineering (LMU, 2016) and a B.Eng in Electrical Engineering (Queen Mary University of London, 2011).

## Current Role
- **Position**: Senior Software QA Engineer (Digital.ai, Remote • Sept 2022 – Present)
- **Specializations**:
  - **LLM Evaluation**: Pioneered LLM evaluation using DeepEval and LLM-as-a-judge frameworks with G-Eval metrics (faithfulness, hallucination, answer relevancy, and bias).
  - **Agentic AI & MCP**: Engineered autonomous Agentic AI workflows using Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers (Playwright MCP) for intelligent multi-step browser automation and end-to-end testing.
  - **Playwright Automation**: Architected scalable Playwright automation frameworks in TypeScript covering 300+ test cases, reducing regression cycle time by 50%.
  - **CI/CD Quality Gates**: Built continuous testing pipelines and automated quality gates in TeamCity, Jenkins, and GitHub Actions.

## Previous Experience
- **Position**: Software Test Engineer (M.M. Hayes Co., Inc., Albany, NY • March 2020 – August 2022)
- **Specializations**: Selenium WebDriver, Java, TestNG, complex backend SQL database testing, and Appium mobile automation across iOS and Android.

## Teaching & STEM Education
- **Students Taught**: 2,000+ learners across global online platforms.
- **Course Rating**: 4.82 / 5.00 average rating.
- **Outschool Instructor**: Coding, Python, AI/ML, and Robotics for ages 9–18.
- **Udemy Courses**: *Python Fundamentals: Fun and Practical Projects for Beginners*.
- **Private Tutoring**: 1-on-1 private Python and AI tutoring at [https://faruk-hasan.com/tutoring/tutoring.html](https://faruk-hasan.com/tutoring/tutoring.html).

## Core Tools & Open Source
- **Playwright Test Results Browser Extension (Chrome Web Store v1.12)**: Chrome extension monitoring Playwright test execution results and live status badges directly from browser toolbar.
- **Moltbook AI Agent**: Autonomous AI agent posting on social media sandbox ([https://github.com/faruklmu17/moltbook_ai_agent](https://github.com/faruklmu17/moltbook_ai_agent)).
- **Student Grader**: Automated grading system with RAG-based personalized feedback ([https://github.com/faruklmu17/student_grader](https://github.com/faruklmu17/student_grader)).
